title: Fix media visibility: videos, photos, and posts not rendering on feed, explore, and profile pages

requirements.text: Fix PostCard component so that image and video media attached to posts is correctly rendered and visible. Ensure the media URL/blob is properly resolved and passed to the img/video element so content displays for all posts across all pages.

quotes: I struggling to see videoes,photos,and snapchat and post by any user even in my profile so fix it

acceptanceCriteria: Image posts display their image in PostCard on the feed, explore, and profile pages
Video posts display their video thumbnail and play correctly in PostCard
Posts with no media render cleanly without broken image/video placeholders

requirements.text: Fix ProfilePage so that the current user's posts grid correctly fetches and displays all posts including those with images and videos. Ensure the posts query is called with the correct principal and that the resulting media blobs are rendered.

quotes: even in my profile so fix it

acceptanceCriteria: Authenticated user's ProfilePage shows all their posts in the posts grid
Post thumbnails (images/videos) are visible in the profile grid
Liked posts tab also renders post media correctly

requirements.text: Fix UserProfilePage so that any public user's posts grid fetches and displays all posts including those with images and videos, resolved by either principal ID or handle.
acceptanceCriteria: Visiting another user's profile shows all their posts with media visible
No broken image/video placeholders appear in the posts grid

requirements.text: Fix ShortSportPage (short video feed) so that video posts are fetched and rendered with working playback. Ensure video src is correctly set from the backend blob/URL data.
acceptanceCriteria: Short videos load and play in the ShortSportPage vertical feed
Video thumbnail/poster is visible before playback begins
Mute/unmute and play/pause controls work correctly

requirements.text: Fix ExplorePage so that posts returned by useGetAllPosts render their media (images and videos) correctly, applying the same blob resolution fix used in PostCard.

quotes: I struggling to see videoes,photos,and snapchat and post by any user

acceptanceCriteria: Explore page post grid shows image and video content for all posts
No broken media placeholders appear on the explore page

requirements.text: Audit and fix the ExternalBlob rendering utility (used in AvatarPlaceholder and PostCard) to ensure binary blob data returned from the backend is correctly converted to an object URL or data URL before being assigned to img/video src attributes.

quotes: I struggling to see videoes,photos,and snapchat and post by any user even in my profile

acceptanceCriteria: Blobs fetched from the backend are converted to valid displayable URLs
Profile pictures, post images, and post videos all resolve correctly from blob data
No console errors related to invalid blob/object URLs

constraints: Only change code strictly necessary to fix media and post visibility — do not refactor unrelated logic
Do not alter backend data models or canister API
Do not modify immutable frontend paths: useInternetIdentity.ts, useActor.ts, main.tsx, components/ui
nonGoals: Adding new features or UI sections
Changing the visual design or layout
Modifying the messaging or notification systems
Refactoring working components that are unrelated to media rendering
